d: The Bulls defeated the Timberwolves, 117-106 tonight in Minnesota. Norman Powell contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 5 rebounds 3 assists and 3 three pointers, with Matas Buzelis of the Bulls adding an additional 18 points (5-9 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Ayo Dosunmu finished with a team-high 24 points along with 5 rebounds for the Timberwolves in the losing effort. The Bulls improve their record to 3-9 with the win, while the Timberwolves fall to 9-4 for the season.
